note: Independent HEAD re-judgment against RFC 7606 Section 2: "thus causing them to be removed from the Adj-RIB-In according to the procedures of [RFC4271]." Read TestAdjRIBInRFC7606TreatAsWithdrawRemovesRoute (positive and negative tags) and producers SynthesizeWithdraw, handleReceivedStructured, installStructuredNLRIs, installStructuredNLRIsWithFilter, putInstalledRouteLocked, removeStructuredNLRIs, and removeReceivedLocked. The tagged test itself is unchanged: it installs 10.0.0.0/8 via a valid UPDATE (requiring ribIn Len==1), then runs a malformed-ORIGIN (len 2) re-announcement through production message.SynthesizeWithdraw (requiring changed==true) and feeds it into handleReceivedStructured, asserting ribIn Len==0. Stale-unit drift came solely from installStructuredNLRIs being refactored to delegate to installStructuredNLRIsWithFilter and putInstalledRouteLocked (added to the code map since handleReceivedStructured calls it directly); non-filtered install and removal behavior and both exact assertions are unchanged. Source re-judgment only; no test or gate run claimed.
